customMethods.name: deleteWorkOrder
customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	workOrderId = self.view.custom.workOrders.selectedWorkOrderId
	
	if workOrderId is None: return
	system.perspective.print("deleteWorkOrder() called with %s"%workOrderId)
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrder(workOrderId, userId)
		
	if msg: 
		system.perspective.print("%s"%msg)
		if 'REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
				msg = "There are actual work orders using this template. Deleting this template will also delete them. Do you still wish to delete?"
				system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'userResponseDeleteAll'}, title='Delete Work Order', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
		else:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Couldn't delete this work order. %s"%msg})
	else: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Work order has been deleted'})
		self.view.custom.workOrders.selectedWorkOrderId = None
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshWorkOrders", {})
	
	return

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("userResponseDeleteAll() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK': 
		userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
		workOrderId = self.view.custom.workOrders.selectedWorkOrderId
		workOrderEvents = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderEvents({'workOrderId': workOrderId}))
		deletedCount = 0
		for workOrderEvent in workOrderEvents:
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrderEvent(workOrderEvent['workOrderEventId'], userId)
			deletedCount += retVal
			
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': '%s Work Order events deleted'%deletedCount})
	
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrder(workOrderId, userId)
		
		self.deleteWorkOrder()
	
	return
